verdict.rationale: PagerDuty's REST API exposes configuration and incident data programmatically (docs-32, docs-39, docs-44), which a technically capable user could use to pull out their data, but there is no documented bulk 'export all my data' feature, data-portability tool, or GDPR-style export mechanism in open formats. Missing for 10: an explicit account-wide export/backup feature, documentation of supported open export formats (CSV/JSON dump), and confirmation that all data types (incidents, schedules, users, workflows) can be fully extracted and are portable to another system.
